name: El Tiempo
body: A strict Referrer-Policy, framing limited to its origin, and robots.txt that lists its sitemaps. But every page analyzed still loads UA-118090425-1, and Universal Analytics stopped processing data by July 2024.
lesson: Search your templates for UA- IDs and remove them. They add a request and collect nothing.
summary: www.eltiempo.com scores 76 out of 100 (C). 3 checks fail now, 19 are at risk, and 22 pass. Fix first: HSTS is not sent.

fix.title: HSTS is not sent
fix.evidence: strict-transport-security was absent on the start page. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed. A first visit over http can be intercepted.

fix.title: 96 form controls have no label
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: 3 AI answer or search crawlers are blocked
fix.evidence: OAI-SearchBot (ChatGPT search) by Disallow: /, ChatGPT-User (ChatGPT, when a person asks it to open a page) by Disallow: /, PerplexityBot (Perplexity answers) by Disallow: /. These bots fetch pages to cite them in answers. Blocked means the site is not…
fix.fix: Allow the answer bots in robots.txt. Training bots can stay blocked if that is the policy.

fix.title: 246 images have no alt attribute
fix.fix: Describe informative images. Give decorative ones alt="".

fix.title: No content security policy
fix.evidence: content-security-policy was absent on the start page. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed. Injected scripts are not limited by the browser.
fix.fix: Start with the Report-Only policy in the fix kit, watch the reports for a week, then enforce it.

fix.title: Universal Analytics code is still on the page
fix.evidence: Google stopped processing Universal Analytics data in July 2024. The code adds weight and collects nothing.
fix.fix: Remove the UA- tag and keep GA4.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
Model-training crawlers are blocked by choice
Plain http redirects permanently to https
The start page declares its language
The start page arrived in 475 ms
Every page has a meta description
